S01: On the distant seas of Malaysia, one man was known as the Tiger of Malaysia.
S02: He was Sandokan, a pirate whose bravery struck fear into the hearts of his enemies.
S03: Sandokan: "I will fight to the end against the enslavers!"
S04: So he did: he gathered a loyal band that would follow him to the end of the world.
S05: His ship chased enemy vessels across the boundless water.
S06: The cannons thundered, and the enemy ship sank beneath the black flag.
S07: But an uneven battle came: a whole fleet surrounded them.
S08: A cannonball struck the deck and the ship began to break apart.
S09: The Tiger's ship keeled over and sank into the raging sea.
S10: Wounded, Sandokan gathered all his strength and swam through the waves.
S11: By dawn he reached the beach at Labuan and collapsed upon the sand.
S12: Some servants found him unconscious on the beach and lifted him in their arms.
S13: When he awoke, Sandokan saw that he lay on a soft bed, in a stranger's house.
S14: Everything was hazy, but he knew he had to hide his true name.
S15: Beside him stood the beautiful Marianna, granddaughter of Lord Guillonk.
S16: If the English discovered his true identity, they would imprison him.
S17: Sandokan: "I am a prince whose ship the sea swallowed."
S19: Days passed, and Sandokan slowly recovered.
S20: On the estate a tiger hunt was being prepared, with British soldiers.
S21: Sandokan entered the forest alone, deep into the heart of the jungle.
S22: Suddenly, face to face, he found himself with the terrible tiger.
S23: Sandokan attacked with his distinctive war cry.
S25: The soldiers captured him and dragged him through the forest.
S26: They threw him into the dark dungeon of the lord's estate.
S27: In chains, in darkness, Sandokan did not lose his defiance.
S28: That night, in Guillonk's palace, the candles of the grand ball were lit.
S29: That stranger was Yanez, Sandokan's faithful right hand, disguised as a Scottish lord.
S30: Yanez: "Come, Tiger. They are singing upstairs."
S31: The two slipped like shadows through the palace and escaped into the night.
S32: On the island of Mompracem, in the hideout, the Tiger regained freedom — but not peace.
S33: Sandokan: "I will come back for you, Marianna."
S34: And so, with his loyal "tigers", he prepared the ship for the return.
S36: On the shore, Sandokan hid among the bushes beside the garden.
S35: The Tiger's ship cut through the night toward Labuan.
S37: Quietly he slipped into the garden and stood in the shadow.
S38: Marianna: "You've returned! I knew you would come."
S39: And she loved him. They had to flee before daybreak.
S40: The two fled through the garden toward the shore, hand in hand.
S41: The Tiger's ship awaited, and they boarded and sailed out onto the open sea.
S42: Labuan remained far behind them, only a shadow on the water.
S43: And on Mompracem, at sunset, they wed before their loyal tigers.
S44: Thus the Tiger of the sea found his home — in the heart of Marianna.
